source.paleography_note: CHAPTER 2 — THE CREATION WEEK as narrated by the angel of the presence to Moses. **4Q216 PRESERVES vv 1-24 SUBSTANTIALLY (the most Hebrew material of any Jubilees chapter)**; **4Q218 PRESERVES vv 26-27 (Sabbath material)**. The Hebrew is therefore primary for nearly the entire chapter. CROSS-CORPUS DENSITY: Genesis 1 is being rewritten verse-by-verse; Jub 2 systematically expands the creation account with angelological taxonomy of day 1 (the seven classes of angels), Eden + Paradise on day 3, the SIGNS-FOR-CALENDAR purpose of luminaries on day 4 (the calendar-polemic seed), and Sabbath-as-Israel-marker on day 7.

verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. v lines 4-9 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994 pp. 11-22) — Hebrew substantially preserved, including the angel-of-presence dictation formula
verses.notes: **INCIPIT OF CHAPTER 2 — the angel of the presence begins his dictation with Genesis-1.** **The narrator-frame: 'The angel of the presence said to Moses according to the word of Yahweh: Write all the words of creation that Yahweh God created on the sixth day in all that he created, and he rested on the seventh day and sanctified it for all generations and set it as a sign for all his works.'** **CROSS-CORPUS — SABBATH-AS-SIGN**: cf. Exod 31:13, 17 ('a sign forever' — אות לעולם); cf. Ezek 20:12, 20. The Sabbath-as-sign framing positions Sabbath as the cosmic-Israelite identity-marker — picked up systematically in vv 17-33 below.

verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. v lines 9-15 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew preserves the SEVEN-CLASSES-OF-ANGELS taxonomy SUBSTANTIALLY; this is one of the most important Hebrew passages in the chapter
verses.notes: **DAY ONE — THE ANGELOLOGICAL TAXONOMY.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — JUBILEES INSERTS AN ELABORATE ANGEL-CLASSIFICATION INTO DAY ONE.** Seven principal classes: (1) **angels of the presence** (mal'akhei ha-panim — including the narrator-angel himself), (2) **angels of sanctification** (mal'akhei ha-qedushah), and elemental-spirits-of: (3) **fire/breath**, (4) **winds**, (5) **clouds/darkness/snow/hail/frost**, (6) **sounds/thunders/lightnings**, (7) **cold/heat/winter/summer/autumn/spring/all seasonal spirits**. **The two HIGHEST classes — 'angels of the presence' and 'angels of sanctification' — are the only ones who keep Sabbath with Israel (cf. v. 18 below) — this is the key Jubilees-distinctive angelological hierarchy.** **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 1 En 60:11-22, 75-76, 80 (similar elemental-spirits taxonomy); cf. Heb 1:7 ('he makes his angels winds and his ministers flames of fire' citing Ps 104:4); cf. 1 En 14:18-22 (the two-class throne hierarchy); cf. 4Q403 1 i (Songs of the Sabbath Sacrifice — angelic praise hierarchy).

verses.text: ואת תהומות ואת החשך ערב ובקר ואת האור ואת השחר ואת האור אשר הכין על דעתו

verses.notes: **The abysses and darkness, evening and morning, and the light which he prepared by his counsel.** Day 1 continues: the abysses (təhōmōt — plural of tehom, Gen 1:2) + light (Gen 1:3-5). The 'light which he prepared by his counsel' is a creation-by-divine-wisdom idiom — cf. Prov 8:22-31; cf. Wis 7:22; cf. John 1:3-9.

verses.notes: **God beholds all he made and blesses all the spirits to serve him.** The 'good' (טוב) of Gen 1:4 here becomes 'blessing.'

verses.notes: **DAY TWO — the firmament in the midst of the waters, half above and half below.** Rewrite of Gen 1:6-8. The 'half above / half below' precision is a Jubilees-distinctive cosmographic clarification — the upper waters above the firmament + the lower waters below it on the earth.

verses.text: וזה לבדו עשה ביום השני ויעש לכל המים מקוה אחד ולים אחד ויאסוף את הכל ויקבץ אותם ויהי מקום נגלה לכל הים

verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vi lines 2-5 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **This alone (the firmament) was made on day 2.** Critical Jubilees-distinctive: Gen 1:9 (gathering of waters) is moved to day 3 here, so that day 2 makes ONLY the firmament. **Day 2 receives no 'and it was good' in Gen 1 — Jubilees explains this by saying day 2's work was incomplete (the gathering-of-waters was held over to day 3).**

verses.text: ויעש ביום הזה השלישי את כל אשר עשה לים ולנהרות ולפלגים ולמעינות לטל ולמטר ולגן עדן בעדן ולכל

verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vi lines 5-9 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **DAY THREE — sea, rivers, streams, springs, dew, rain, AND THE GARDEN OF EDEN IN EDEN.** **CRITICAL: Garden of Eden is placed on DAY 3 — embedded into the creation week proper, not as a post-creation event (Gen 2:8).** This is a Jubilees-distinctive: Eden is part of the cosmic ordering, not a subsequent installation. Eden as primordial-cosmic-garden picked up in 1 En 24-25 (the mountain of God), 4 Ezra 7:36, and rabbinic Pirqe Avot 5:6 (Eden created in twilight of day 6).

verses.text: ויעש ביום הרביעי את השמש ואת הירח ואת הכוכבים ויתנם ברקיע השמים להאיר על כל הארץ ולמשול ביום ובלילה ולהבדיל בין האור ובין החשך

verses.text: ויתן יהוה את השמש לאות גדול על הארץ לימים ולשבתות ולחדשים ולמועדים ולשנים ולשבועי שנים וליובלים ולכל תקופות השנים

verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vi lines 13-17 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew preserves THE FULL CALENDRICAL EXPANSION OF GEN 1:14 ('signs and seasons and days and years'); the SEVEN-FOLD CALENDAR ENUMERATION (days/sabbaths/months/feasts/years/year-weeks/jubilees) is the KEY Jubilees calendar-text
verses.notes: **THE CALENDRICAL EXPANSION OF GEN 1:14 — the foundational Jubilees calendar text.** **MAJOR CROSS-CORPUS — 364-DAY SOLAR CALENDAR POLEMIC**: **'the sun as a great sign for days and sabbaths and months and festivals and years and year-weeks and jubilees and for ALL THE CIRCUITS OF THE YEARS'** — note the **CONSPICUOUS OMISSION OF MOON-RECKONING from the calendrical purpose of the luminaries**. Gen 1:14 makes both luminaries 'for signs and seasons.' Jubilees here assigns calendar-function to the SUN ALONE — this is the foundational solar-calendrical-polemic against lunar-month reckoning. **Bidirectional with v2.67.0 glossary entry `qumran-364-day-solar-calendar-polemic-1-enoch-72-82-jubilees-cross-corpus`** + 1 En 72-82, 4Q317, 4Q319-4Q330 Mishmarot. **Sevenfold calendar enumeration**: days/sabbaths/months/feasts/years/year-weeks (heptads)/jubilees — this is the 49-year jubilee calendrical-grid of the entire book.

verses.text: ויבדל בין האור ובין החשך לבריאות ויהי כן ויקרא לאור יום ולחשך קרא לילה
verses.translit: wa-yabdēl bēn hā-ʾōr ū-bēn ha-ḥōšek li-brīʾūt wa-yhī kēn wa-yiqrāʾ lā-ʾōr yōm wə-la-ḥōšek qārāʾ laylāh
verses.text_geez: ወፈለጠ፡ ማእከለ፡ ብርሃን፡ ወማእከለ፡ ጽልመት፡ ለፈውስ፡ ወኮነ፡ ከማሁ፡ ወጸውዐ፡ ለብርሃን፡ መዓልተ፡ ወለጽልመት፡ ጸውዐ፡ ሌሊተ፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vi lines 17-19 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **Separates light and darkness 'for healing' (li-brīʾūt) — a notable Jubilees-distinctive: the luminaries-separation has a HEALING-FUNCTION.** Picked up in 1 En 50:1 (eschatological luminaries-renewal for healing — cf. Jub 1:29 above) and Mal 3:20 ('the sun of righteousness with healing in its wings').

verses.text: ויעש ביום החמישי את התנינים הגדולים בתוך מי תהומות כי הם נעשו ראשונה במים וכל בשר הזוחל ועוף השמים וכל אשר עף
verses.translit: wa-yaʿaś ba-yōm ha-ḥămīšī ʾet ha-tannīnīm ha-gədōlīm bə-tōk mē təhōmōt kī hēm naʿăśū rīʾšōnāh ba-mayim wə-kol bāśār ha-zōḥēl wə-ʿōp ha-šāmayim wə-kol ʾăšer ʿāp
verses.text_geez: ወገብረ፡ በዕለት፡ ኃምስት፡ አዕናተ፡ ዐበይተ፡ ውስተ፡ ማእከለ፡ ማያት፡ ማዕምቃት፡ እስመ፡ እሙንቱ፡ ተገብሩ፡ ቀዳሚተ፡ በውስተ፡ ማይ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ሥጋ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ወአዕዋፈ፡ ሰማይ፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘይሰርር፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vi lines 19-22 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **DAY FIVE — great sea-serpents (tanninim) and water-creatures and birds.** Note: 'the great sea-serpents were made FIRST in the water' is a Jubilees-distinctive ordering. Rewrite of Gen 1:20-23. The 'great tannin' = Leviathan in later tradition (cf. Job 41; cf. 1 En 60:7-9, 4 Ezra 6:49-52 where Leviathan and Behemoth are created on day 5 to be eschatological-banquet food).

verses.text: ויעש ביום הששי את כל חיתו הארץ ואת כל הבהמה ואת כל אשר רומש על הארץ
verses.translit: wa-yaʿaś ba-yōm ha-šiššī ʾet kol ḥaytō hā-ʾāreṣ wə-ʾet kol ha-bəhēmāh wə-ʾet kol ʾăšer rōmēś ʿal hā-ʾāreṣ
verses.text_geez: ወገብረ፡ በዕለት፡ ስድስት፡ ኵሎ፡ አራዊተ፡ ምድር፡ ወኵሎ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወኵሎ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vi lines 22-23 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **DAY SIX — beasts of the earth, cattle, creeping things.** Rewrite of Gen 1:24-25.

verses.text: ואחרי כל זאת עשה את האדם איש ואשה עשה אותם וימשילהו על כל אשר על הארץ ובים ועל העוף ועל החיה ועל הבהמה ועל כל הארץ ועל כל אשר רומש על הארץ
verses.translit: wə-ʾaḥărē kol zōʾt ʿāśāh ʾet hā-ʾādām ʾīš wə-ʾiššāh ʿāśāh ʾōtām wa-yamšīlēhū ʿal kol ʾăšer ʿal hā-ʾāreṣ ū-ba-yām wə-ʿal hā-ʿōp wə-ʿal ha-ḥayyāh wə-ʿal ha-bəhēmāh wə-ʿal kol hā-ʾāreṣ wə-ʿal kol ʾăšer rōmēś ʿal hā-ʾāreṣ
verses.text_geez: ወእምድኅረ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ ገብረ፡ ሰብአ፡ ብእሲ፡ ወብእሲተ፡ ገብሮሙ፡ ወሤሞ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ ወላዕለ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ ወላዕለ፡ አራዊት፡ ወላዕለ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ምድር፡ ወላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vii lines 1-5 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **CREATION OF MAN — male and female, with dominion over fish/birds/beasts/earth.** Rewrite of Gen 1:26-28.

verses.text: ועל אלה ארבעת המינים השליטו ביום הששי וכל המעשה אשר עשה השלים ובכל אשר עשה היו עשרים ושנים מיני בריאה
verses.translit: wə-ʿal ʾēlleh ʾarbaʿat ha-mīnīm hišlīṭō ba-yōm ha-šiššī wə-kol ha-maʿăśeh ʾăšer ʿāśāh hišlīm ū-bə-kol ʾăšer ʿāśāh hāyū ʿeśrīm ū-šənayim mīnē bərīʾāh
verses.text_geez: ወላዕለ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ኵሉ፡ አርባዕቱ፡ ዘመድ፡ ሤሞ፡ በዕለት፡ ስድስት፡ ወኵሎ፡ ግብር፡ ዘገብረ፡ ፈጸመ፡ ወበኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ኮኑ፡ ዕሥራ፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ ዘመድ፡ ፍጥረት፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vii lines 5-8 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial; the TWENTY-TWO CATEGORIES count attested
verses.notes: **TWENTY-TWO KINDS OF CREATION.** **CRITICAL JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — TWENTY-TWO**: matches the twenty-two Hebrew letters AND the twenty-two generations from Adam to Jacob (Jub 2:23). This is gematria-style cosmic-numerological framing: creation = alphabet = patriarchal genealogy. Cross-corpus: cf. Sefer Yetzirah (creation by twenty-two letters); cf. Josephus Contra Apionem 1.38-40 (twenty-two books of Scripture matched to letters). **The 22-twofold (cosmic + genealogical) is one of the most distinctive Jubilees numerological structures.**

verses.text: וישלם השם את כל מעשהו ביום השביעי ויברך אותם ויקדש אותם
verses.translit: wa-yašlēm ha-šēm ʾet kol maʿăśēhū ba-yōm ha-šəbīʿī wa-yəbārek ʾōtām wa-yəqaddēš ʾōtām
verses.text_geez: ወፈጸመ፡ ስም፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብሮ፡ በዕለት፡ ሳብዕት፡ ወባረኮ፡ ወቀደሶ፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vii lines 8-10 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **Completion + blessing + sanctifying of the Sabbath.** Rewrite of Gen 2:1-3.

verses.text: ככה נתן לאות לכל מעשיו אשר ברא לעשות שש ימים יעבוד וביום השביעי ישבת מכל אשר עשה
verses.translit: kā-kāh nātan lə-ʾōt lə-kol maʿăśāyw ʾăšer bārāʾ la-ʿăśōt šēš yāmīm yaʿăbōd ū-ba-yōm ha-šəbīʿī yišbōt mi-kol ʾăšer ʿāśāh
verses.text_geez: ከመዝ፡ ወሀበ፡ ለትእምርት፡ ለኵሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ ዘፈጠረ፡ ለግቢር፡ ስድስቱ፡ ዕለት፡ ይትገበር፡ ወበዕለት፡ ሳብዕት፡ ይትዐረፍ፡ እምኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vii lines 10-12 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **Sabbath-as-sign: 'six days he shall work and on the seventh day he shall rest from all he has done.'** Direct citation of Exod 20:9-11 / Exod 31:15-17. Sabbath inscribed into creation-week.

verses.text: ויתן את שבתות לכל מעשיו אשר עשה ולנו לבדנו נתנם לעשות ולאכל ולשתות לפני יהוה אלהינו
verses.translit: wa-yittēn ʾet šabbətōt lə-kol maʿăśāyw ʾăšer ʿāśāh wə-lā-nū lə-baddēnū nətān-ām la-ʿăśōt wə-leʾĕkōl wə-li-štōt li-pnē YHWH ʾĕlōhēnū
verses.text_geez: ወወሀበ፡ ሰናብተ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ግብሩ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ወለነ፡ ለባሕቲትነ፡ ወሀበነ፡ ከመ፡ ንግበር፡ ወንብላዕ፡ ወንስተይ፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚአብሔር፡ አምላክነ፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vii lines 12-15 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial; the KEY 'TO US ALONE' (lā-nū lə-baddēnū) is attested — this is the distinctive Jubilees Sabbath-as-Israel-marker formula
verses.notes: **SABBATH-AS-ISRAEL-MARKER — 'TO US ALONE.'** **CRITICAL JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE: the Sabbath is given exclusively to Israel — 'to us alone he gave it' (לנו לבדנו).** This is the Jubilees-distinctive sectarian sabbatology — Sabbath is NOT universal but Israel-and-the-two-highest-angel-classes-only (cf. v. 18 below). Cross-corpus: cf. m. Sanh. 8:6, b. Sanh. 58b ('a Gentile who keeps Sabbath is liable to death') — late rabbinic intensification of the same exclusivity. Contrast Mark 2:27 ('Sabbath was made for man'); contrast Isa 56:6-7 (Sabbath open to foreigners). **The Jubilees position is at the extreme exclusivist end of Second Temple Sabbath theology.**

verses.text: כי הוא בחר בנו מכל העמים אשר ראה לעשות עם לו ושבת קדש לכל הימים ויקדישנו לו וברכנו ויאמר אלינו ויעלה לפניו זרענו לזכר עם רוחות הקדושים והפנים אשר היו לפניו לכל הימים
verses.translit: kī hūʾ bāḥar bā-nū mi-kol hā-ʿammīm ʾăšer rāʾāh la-ʿăśōt ʿam lō wə-šabbat qōdeš lə-kol ha-yāmīm wa-yəqaddīšēnū lō ū-bērkānū wa-yōʾmer ʾēlēnū wə-yaʿăleh lə-pānāyw zarʿēnū lə-zēker ʿim rūḥōt ha-qədōšīm wə-ha-pānīm ʾăšer hāyū lə-pānāyw lə-kol ha-yāmīm
verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ ኪያነ፡ ኀርየ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ አሕዛብ፡ ዘርእየ፡ ለገቢረ፡ ሕዝብ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወሰንበተ፡ ቅድሳት፡ ለኵሉ፡ መዋዕል፡ ወቀደሰነ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወባረከነ፡ ወይቤለነ፡ ወይዐርግ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ዘርእነ፡ ለመዝከር፡ ምስለ፡ መናፍሰ፡ ቅዱሳን፡ ወመላእክተ፡ ገጽ፡ እለ፡ ሀለዉ፡ ቅድሜሁ፡ ኵሎ፡ መዋዕለ፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vii lines 15-19 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **SABBATH KEPT BY ISRAEL + THE TWO HIGHEST ANGEL-CLASSES.** **CRITICAL JUBILEES-DISTINCTIVE — JOINT SABBATH OBSERVANCE.** Israel + the angels of the presence + the angels of sanctification all keep Sabbath together — the same two angel-classes named in 2:2. **The other elemental-spirit classes do NOT keep Sabbath.** Israel's terrestrial Sabbath synchronizes with the celestial Sabbath of the highest two angelic orders. **CROSS-CORPUS**: cf. 4Q400-4Q407 (Songs of the Sabbath Sacrifice — angelic Sabbath-worship system); cf. Heb 4:9-10 (sabbatismos for the people of God); cf. Rev 4:8 (the four living creatures praising perpetually). **This celestial-Sabbath-with-angels framing is foundational to the entire Qumran liturgical-cosmology.**

verses.text: ויאמר אלי הנה אבדיל לי עם מתוך כל עמי ושמרו השבת ואקדישם לי לעם והרכתי אותם והם יהיו לי לעם ואני אהיה להם לאלהים
verses.translit: wa-yōʾmer ʾēlay hinnēh ʾabdīl lī ʿam mi-tōk kol ʿammāy wə-šāmrū ha-šabbāt wa-ʾaqdīšēm lī lə-ʿām wə-hērakhtī ʾōtām wə-hēm yihyū lī lə-ʿām wa-ʾănī ʾehyeh lā-hem lē-ʾlōhīm
verses.text_geez: ወይቤለኒ፡ ናሁ፡ እፈልጥ፡ ሊተ፡ ሕዝበ፡ እማእከለ፡ ኵሉ፡ አሕዛብየ፡ ወይዕቀቡ፡ ሰንበተ፡ ወእቄድሶሙ፡ ለሕዝብየ፡ ወእባርኮሙ፡ ወእሙንቱ፡ ይከውኑኒ፡ ሕዝበ፡ ወአንሰ፡ እከውኖሙ፡ አምላከ፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. vii lines 19-22 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **Election + covenant-formula reprised.** 'I will separate a people from among all my peoples' — election theology. Covenant formula 'they shall be my people, I shall be their God' echoes 1:8 above.

verses.text: ובחרתי בזרע יעקב מבני כל אשר ראיתי וכתבתיו לי לבן בכור ואקדישו אלי לעולם
verses.translit: ū-bāḥartī bə-zeraʿ Yaʿăqōb mi-bənē kol ʾăšer rāʾītī wə-kətabtīw lī lə-bēn bəkōr wa-ʾaqdīšō ʾēlay lə-ʿōlām
verses.text_geez: ወኀረይኩ፡ ዘርአ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ እምነ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘርእኩ፡ ወጸሐፍክዎ፡ ሊተ፡ ወልደ፡ በኵረ፡ ወቀደስክዎ፡ ለዓለም፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. viii lines 1-3 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial; 'firstborn son' (בן בכור) of Israel attested
verses.notes: **ISRAEL AS FIRSTBORN SON.** **CROSS-CORPUS — FIRSTBORN ISRAEL**: cf. Exod 4:22 ('Israel is my firstborn son'); cf. Jer 31:9. The 'wrote him for myself' phrasing invokes the heavenly-tablets motif: Jacob's election is inscribed on the heavenly tablets — bidirectional with the heavenly-tablets glossary entry.

verses.text: ואת השבת אודיע להם למען יעשו את היום הזה זכרון לכל מעשה הימים
verses.translit: wə-ʾet ha-šabbāt ʾōdīaʿ lā-hem lə-maʿan yaʿăśū ʾet ha-yōm ha-zeh zikkārōn lə-kol maʿăśēh ha-yāmīm
verses.text_geez: ወሰንበተ፡ አርእዮሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ ዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ለመዝከር፡ ለኵሉ፡ ግብረ፡ መዋዕል፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. viii lines 3-5 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **Sabbath as memorial of all creation-week works.**

verses.text: השם ברך והקדיש את עם ישראל לעבוד בו השבת ולנוח בו ולעשות בו את הזכרון לפי החפש אשר עשה
verses.translit: ha-šēm bērak wə-hiqdīš ʾet ʿam Yiśrāʾēl la-ʿăbōd bō ha-šabbāt wə-lā-nūaḥ bō wə-la-ʿăśōt bō ʾet ha-zikkārōn lə-pī ha-ḥōpeš ʾăšer ʿāśāh
verses.text_geez: ስም፡ ባረከ፡ ወቀደሰ፡ ሕዝበ፡ እስራኤል፡ ለግቢር፡ ሰንበት፡ ወለማዕረፍ፡ ወለመዝከር፡ በከመ፡ ግብሩ፡ ዘገብረ፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. viii lines 5-8 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial
verses.notes: **Sabbath consecrated for Israel — to work-it/keep-it + rest + commemorate.**

verses.text: כי עשרים ושנים ראשי האדם היו מאדם עד יעקב והכל ברך וקדש וכלם נכתבו לו ויקדש את האחרון
verses.translit: kī ʿeśrīm ū-šənayim rāʾšē hā-ʾādām hāyū mē-ʾādām ʿad Yaʿăqōb wə-ha-kōl bērak wə-qiddēš wə-kullām niktəbū lō wa-yəqaddēš ʾet hā-ʾaḥărōn
verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ ዕሥራ፡ ወክልኤቱ፡ ርእስ፡ ለሰብእ፡ ኮኑ፡ እምአዳም፡ እስከ፡ ያዕቆብ፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ ባረከ፡ ወቀደሰ፡ ወኵሎሙ፡ ተጽሕፉ፡ ሎቱ፡ ወቀደሰ፡ ለደኃራዊ፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. viii lines 8-10 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial; the TWENTY-TWO HEAD-PATRIARCHS count attested
verses.notes: **THE TWENTY-TWO GENERATIONS FROM ADAM TO JACOB.** **MATCHES THE TWENTY-TWO KINDS OF CREATION (2:14).** **Cosmic-creation-categories = patriarchal-generations = Hebrew-alphabet-letters = JACOB'S COVENANT-IDENTITY** — Jacob is the 22nd generation, sealing the cosmic structure. **The numerological match is intentional and signals the entire book's structuring philosophy**: creation and Israel's election are isomorphic. Cross-corpus: cf. Josephus C. Ap. 1.38-40 (twenty-two books = alphabet); cf. b. Pesahim 87b; cf. Sefer Yetzirah.

verses.text: וזה היה זרעו של יעקב כי ראש לכל הוא ועם בנו לחקה לכל הדורות
verses.translit: wə-zeh hāyāh zarʿō šel Yaʿăqōb kī rōʾš lə-kol hūʾ wə-ʿam bənō lə-ḥuqqāh lə-kol ha-dōrōt
verses.text_geez: ወዘርኡ፡ ኮነ፡ ለያዕቆብ፡ እስመ፡ ርእስ፡ ለኵሉ፡ ውእቱ፡ ወምስለ፡ ወልዱ፡ ለሥርዐት፡ ለኵሉ፡ ትውልድ፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q216 col. viii lines 10-13 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial; THIS IS THE LAST VERSE PRESERVED IN 4Q216
verses.notes: **Jacob's seed as the patriarchal head of all generations.** **AFTER THIS VERSE, 4Q216 BREAKS OFF; v. 25 IS GE'EZ-ONLY; vv. 26-27 ARE PRESERVED IN 4Q218 (Jubileesc).**

verses.text_geez: ወፈጣሪ፡ ኵሉ፡ ባረኮ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ዘፈጠራ፡ ለበረከት፡ ወለቅድሳት፡ ወለስብሐት፡ እምኵሉ፡ ዕለታት፡
verses.translit: wa-faṭāri kwəlu bārakō la-zāti ʿəlat za-faṭarā la-baraka wa-la-qədsāt wa-la-səbḥat ʾəm-kwəlu ʿəlatāt
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 2:25; VanderKam 1989) — 4Q216 not preserved at this verse
verses.notes: **'The Creator of all blessed this day which he created for blessing and sanctification and glory above all days.'** Sabbath-supremacy formula — bridges to the Sabbath-violation penalties of vv. 26-33.

verses.text: כל אשר חלל את היום הזה מות יומת וכל אשר עשה עליו מלאכה מות יומת לעולם למען שמרו בני ישראל את היום הזה לדורותם
verses.translit: kol ʾăšer ḥillēl ʾet ha-yōm ha-zeh mōt yūmāt wə-kol ʾăšer ʿāśāh ʿālāyw məlāʾkāh mōt yūmāt lə-ʿōlām lə-maʿan šāmrū bənē Yiśrāʾēl ʾet ha-yōm ha-zeh lə-dōrōtām
verses.text_geez: ኵሉ፡ ዘያረኵሳ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ሞተ፡ ይሙት፡ ወኵሉ፡ ዘገብረ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ግብረ፡ ሞተ፡ ይሙት፡ ለዓለም፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀብዋ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ለዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q218 (Jubileesc) frag 1 lines 1-5 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994 pp. 35-38) — Hebrew partially preserved; **4Q218 IS A DIFFERENT MANUSCRIPT than 4Q216 — early 1st c. BCE — preserves precisely the Sabbath-penalty material here**
verses.notes: **WITNESS CHANGE — 4Q218 IS NOW PRIMARY.** **Sabbath-violation = death-penalty.** Direct citation of Exod 31:14-15, Exod 35:2, Num 15:32-36. **Cross-corpus**: Qumran sectarian intensification: CD 11:14-15, 12:3-6 (Damascus Document Sabbath rules). The Jubilees Sabbath-penalty maximalism shapes the Qumran sectarian halakhic tradition.

verses.text: כל איש אשר יעשה בו מלאכה ואשר יצא במסע ואשר ישאר בו עבודת אדמה ובית או דבר אחר ואשר ידליק עליו אש ואשר ירכב בכל בהמה ואשר יסע באניה בים מות יומת
verses.translit: kol ʾīš ʾăšer yaʿăśeh bō məlāʾkāh wa-ʾăšer yēṣēʾ bə-massāʿ wa-ʾăšer yēšārēr bō ʿăbōdat ʾădāmāh ū-bayit ʾō dābār ʾaḥēr wa-ʾăšer yadlīq ʿālāyw ʾēš wa-ʾăšer yirkab bə-kol bəhēmāh wa-ʾăšer yissaʿ bā-ʾŏniyyāh ba-yām mōt yūmāt
verses.text_geez: ኵሉ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይገብር፡ ውስቴታ፡ ግብረ፡ ወዘይወፅእ፡ ለፍኖት፡ ወዘይትቀነይ፡ ግብረ፡ ምድር፡ ወቤት፡ ወዘውእቱ፡ ካልእ፡ ግብር፡ ወዘያንድድ፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ እሳተ፡ ወዘይጼዐን፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወዘይነግድ፡ በሐመር፡ ውስተ፡ ባሕር፡ ሞተ፡ ይሙት፡
verses.witness_primary: 4Q218 frag 1 lines 5-11 (Milik-VanderKam DJD XIII 1994) — Hebrew partial; **the explicit prohibitions list (travel, fire, riding, boats) is one of the densest Hebrew Sabbath-halakhah passages in the DSS**
verses.notes: **EXPLICIT SABBATH PROHIBITIONS LIST.** **CROSS-CORPUS — JUBILEES SECTARIAN SABBATH HALAKHAH**: travel ('going out on a journey'), agricultural labor, kindling fire, riding animals, sailing — all death-penalty Sabbath violations. **CROSS-CORPUS to Qumran**: cf. CD 10:14-11:18 (Damascus Document — the most extensive Qumran Sabbath legislation, with strong parallels to this list); cf. 4Q251 (Halakhah A — Sabbath rules); cf. 4Q264a (Halakhah B — Sabbath rules). **CROSS-CORPUS to NT**: the Sabbath disputes of Mark 2:23-3:6, Luke 13:14, John 5:9-18, John 9:14 should be read against this Jubilees-maximalist halakhic backdrop. The 'kindling no fire' prohibition (Exod 35:3) is the foundational rabbinic Sabbath-rule. **AFTER THIS VERSE, 4Q218 BREAKS OFF; vv. 28-33 ARE GE'EZ-ONLY.**

verses.text_geez: ወኵሉ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይገብር፡ ላዕሌሃ፡ ኵሎ፡ ግብረ፡ ይሙት፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀብዋ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ለዛቲ፡ ሰንበት፡ በከመ፡ ተአዘዙ፡ ለሰናብት፡ ምድር፡ በከመ፡ ጽሑፍ፡ ውስተ፡ ጽላት፡ ዘወሀበኒ፡ ውስተ፡ እዴየ፡ ከመ፡ እጽሐፍ፡ ሎሙ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ መዋዕል፡
verses.translit: wa-kwəlu bəʾəsi za-yəgabbər lāʿlēhā kwəlo gəbra yəmut kama yəʿqəbwā daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl la-zāti sanbat ba-kama taʾəzazu la-sanābta mədr ba-kama ṣəḥuf wəsta ṣəlāt zawahabani wəsta ʾədēya kama ʾəṣəḥaf lomu śərʿata mawāʿəl
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 2:28-30; VanderKam 1989) — 4Q218 ends at v. 27
verses.notes: **Continuing Sabbath halakhah + reference to the angel-of-presence handing Moses the tablets to write the divisions-of-time on.** Heavenly-tablets motif (bidirectional with v2.67.0).

verses.text_geez: ወይቤለኒ፡ አንተ፡ ንግሮሙ፡ ለደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ወአዝዞሙ፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀብዋ፡ ለዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ከመ፡ ይትቀደሱ፡ ቦ፡ ወከመ፡ ይኩኖሙ፡ ለትእምርት፡ ለኵሉ፡ መዋዕል፡
verses.translit: wa-yəbēlani ʾanta nəgəromu la-daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl wa-ʾəzəzomu kama yəʿqəbwā la-zāti ʿəlat kama yətqaddasu bo wa-kama yəkunomu la-təʾəmərt la-kwəlu mawāʿəl
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 2:30; VanderKam 1989)
verses.notes: **Moses commissioned to teach Israel Sabbath-keeping as their perpetual sign.**

verses.text_geez: ወኵሉ፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይዕቀባ፡ ይኩን፡ ቅዱሰ፡ ወቡሩከ፡ ኵሎ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ከመ፡ ንኩን፡ ንሕነ፡
verses.translit: wa-kwəlu bəʾəsi za-yəʿqəbā yəkun qəddusa wa-buruka kwəlo mawāʿəla kama nəkun nəḥna
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 2:30; VanderKam 1989)
verses.notes: **'Anyone who keeps it shall be holy and blessed all his days, as we are.'** **The angelic 'we' speaks — the narrator is the angel of the presence, identifying Israel's Sabbath-keeping with angelic-status.**

verses.text_geez: ይኩን፡ መዝከር፡ ለበረከት፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘርእ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡ ምስለ፡ መላእክተ፡ ገጽ፡ ወምስለ፡ መላእክተ፡ ቅድሳት፡
verses.translit: yəkun mazkar la-baraka lāʿla kwəlu zarʾ daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl la-təwlədomu la-ʿālam məsla malāʾəkta gaṣṣ wa-məsla malāʾəkta qədsāt
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 2:31; VanderKam 1989)
verses.notes: **Sabbath as memorial + blessing for Israel forever, WITH the angels of the presence and the angels of sanctification.** **Re-emphasizes the joint angelic-Israelite Sabbath observance — the central Jubilees Sabbath theology.**

verses.text_geez: እስመ፡ ዐባይ፡ ዛቲ፡ ዕለት፡ ወቡርክት፡ ወሕያው፡ ይኩን፡ ብእሲ፡ ዘይዕቀብ፡ በቅድሳት፡ ለበረከት፡ ኵሎ፡ ዓመተ፡ ሕይወቱ፡
verses.translit: ʾəsma ʿabāy zāti ʿəlat wa-buruktə wa-ḥəyāw yəkun bəʾəsi za-yəʿqəb ba-qədsāt la-baraka kwəlo ʿāmata ḥəywatu
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 2:32; VanderKam 1989)
verses.notes: **'For this day is great and blessed.'** Sabbath as greatest day. cf. b. Berakhot 57b (Sabbath as 'one-sixtieth of the world to come').

verses.text_geez: ዝንቱ፡ ሕግ፡ ወትእምርት፡ ሰናብት፡ ላዕለ፡ እስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ ይዕቀብዎ፡ ለሰንበት፡ ለትውልዶሙ፡ ለዓለም፡
verses.translit: zəntu ḥəg wa-təʾəmərt sanābt lāʿla ʾəsrāʾēl kama yəʿqəbwō la-sanbat la-təwlədomu la-ʿālam
verses.witness_primary: Ge'ez (Charles 1902 2:33; VanderKam 1989)
verses.notes: **Closing summation: this is the eternal law and sign of Sabbaths for Israel.** Sabbath-law-sign-perpetuity formula closes the chapter. Cross-corpus: cf. Exod 31:17 ('a sign forever between me and the sons of Israel').
